slow_cpu_observations.summary_scope: All 65536 original client observations reduced by finalized height. No database was opened and no internal stage diagnosis is inferred.

conclusions: All three rounds passed 65536 receipts, balances, account authority, fees, nonce and original cold recovery. Each used 64 delivered input frames and 64 finalized 1024-row candidates with no recorded transport/nonce/business failure.

The repeated CPU run is a preserved negative: 1496.538478 TPS and P95/P99 17.017242/17.325802 seconds, versus first CPU 2490.169235 TPS and 4.169760/4.727761 seconds. Functional pass is not stable performance acceptance.

GPU-required 2748.529128 TPS is only one observed sample, not 12K recovery or a universal GPU win. Its startup-through-four-receipts wall is 27.6226787 seconds versus first CPU 26.8846838 seconds despite shorter transaction timing.

The generic dynamic driver does not promise same bytes across runs, but these three final raw hashes, genesis and initial roots actually match. Report the observed identity without converting it into a future driver guarantee.

Slow CPU all-four observation gaps concentrate at h41 (4.468519 seconds after h40) and h42 (9.577445 seconds after h41); h42 was first submitted at 14.979916 seconds and first observed across four nodes at approximately 31.045-31.090 seconds. This is an observation window, not proof that journal or consensus itself paused for that entire duration.

Diagnostics were off. Internal execution, proposal/QC, publication and query visibility cannot be separated for this slow 65K run. Do not blame the signing algorithm, early-body fanout, disk or query observer without further evidence.

continuous_generator_starved_poll_us counts full original SDK poll turns whenever prepared input is exhausted and more rows remain, including when the outstanding ceiling prevents starting another generator. It is not pure signer idle time. Generation task and poll timings overlap and cannot be added or subtracted from total TPS.

Stage1 continuous samples used another corpus/domain and separate sessions. Comparisons to stage1 are descriptive, not a same-input before/after isolation; the separate strict 4096 phase1/phase2 fixture is the controlled comparison.
No final static 65536 run was performed in this phase. Real multihost, physical wire/retransmission/peak-memory measurements, full candidate CI and formal deployment remain outside this acceptance.
